name: marin
description: Open-source framework for the research and development of foundation models.
one_liner: An open framework for researchers to build and experiment with their own large AI language models from scratch.
buyer: An AI research lab or university group, not a typical business buyer.
business_use_cases: A university AI lab uses it to train and publish reproducible research models instead of building infra from scratch.
A startup building a niche domain-specific model (legal, medical) uses it as its training framework.
A cloud provider offers a managed 'foundation model training' service built on top of it.

money_ideas.idea: Offer consulting/managed training services helping companies build custom foundation models on this framework.

steal_this: Not a weekend build — this is deep infra for AI research teams, not solo builders.
